title: A narrow ledge
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the outside wall of the weathered stone lighthouse tower on its cliff, with iron rungs, ledges and wet masonry, waves exploding on the rocks far below. Time and weather: darkening storm at dusk, cold slate-blue light, rain, lightning on the horizon.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important.
Camera: side tracking shot along the tower wall, sheer drop below; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Tomkin scrambles across a narrow ledge of wet masonry on the outside of the tower, hugging the butter tub, claws scrabbling for grip, cape flapping, waves exploding on the rocks far below.
No dialogue.
Sound: scrabbling claws on stone, crumbling grit, wind, distant surf.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
